Why

The collector concurrency change was integrated in [#1339](https://github.com/luizanunciostoca/touristic-digital-platform/pull/1339), merge `65f743f075edb433c10ea2849306fe125229dd43`. Its active claim must now be retired through the canonical merged-PR lifecycle so the control registry reflects the integrated result.

## Transition

Generated by current-main `mdctl claim retire` using genuine GitHub provider reads and reason **MERGED_PR**. The qualifying evidence is the material PR #1339 and its main ancestry, not the acquisition-only PR #1338.

Exactly three metadata files change:

- Remove only `MD-RETIREMENT-BLOB-CONCURRENCY-20261101` from active claims; the other nine claims remain semantically identical.
- Append `MERGED` and `CLAIM_RELEASED` events, both bound to PR #1339 and its actual merge SHA.
- Set this manifest to `MERGED`, with the retirement base and branch. Ownership, risk, proof plan and authority scope stay identical.

## Exact candidate and validation

- Base: `65f743f075edb433c10ea2849306fe125229dd43`.
- Candidate: `b00445c3044a9caf8f5fcf047c87623c43a67511`.
- Tree: `881f1f9a8d150122e0d137e75bccac05b4a89bd2`.
- Clean PREPARE and ADMISSION passed.
- Final CERTIFY: **434 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**, bound to this exact candidate and tree.
- Independent review: **PASS, zero findings**, including independent provider attribution and unchanged surviving claims.
- Post-#1339 main regression: **51 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**; counts overlap with CERTIFY and do not represent distinct journeys.
- Original material workspace and four original task-history files remain intact. Original task is SUBMITTED; original leases are RELEASED.

One prior local CERTIFY attempt inherited the optional `gh` transport setting into a test of absent opt-in and therefore failed that fixture (433 pass / 1 fail). The final run used the official in-memory authentication wrapper and genuine fetch with the inherited proxy/system CA via supported Node flags. The same untouched candidate then passed all 434 tests; no assertion or source was changed to obtain the pass.

## Boundaries

This is only the collector claim retirement. Coverage and WP06 claims remain unchanged. It does not retire the coverage claim, reuse expired owner consent, prove cumulative live-collection timing, or deploy the application.

## Remote proof and review reconciliation

Final-head readback: **16 successful checks, 16 intentionally skipped, no failures or pending checks**. Zero review threads.

- [Trusted retirement proof](https://github.com/luizanunciostoca/touristic-digital-platform/actions/runs/41262146370/job/124717508205): 51 tests pass; provider proof reports exact head `b00445c3044a9caf8f5fcf047c87623c43a67511`, current base `65f743f075edb433c10ea2849306fe125229dd43`, one removed claim, reason MERGED_PR, actual PR #1339 and both owned material paths.
- [Core Quality](https://github.com/luizanunciostoca/touristic-digital-platform/actions/runs/41262146254/job/124717484190): success; 22-test and 403-test selections pass without failures or skips. Counts overlap with other suites.
- [Merge Gate](https://github.com/luizanunciostoca/touristic-digital-platform/actions/runs/41262146236/job/124717412961): POLICY_SATISFIED, mode CLAIM_RETIREMENT, exact head/base, no unresolved review threads.

Provider review at 2026-11-01T01:43:27Z found **no open code issues**, with an explicit reservation that final remote evidence still required reconciliation. The exact-head provider results above resolve that reservation; no material change or new candidate was needed. This is not represented as a formal APPROVED review.

Candidate frozen for integration, subject to readiness-triggered checks, fresh main/head readback and expected-head merge.
